dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: Now you mention it, a guy I work with said he'd seen some Crystal Ore not far from here.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: But work's so busy I don't have the time to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: If you're interested, you should go and look into it. Here, I'll mark the location for you...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shoulder
dialogues.text: ...There. That's the rough area, anyway. Mining's a good, honest job — so off you go, maybe it'll do you some good!
